extension.description: Copy path with line numbers, change case, align by regex, and a plain text mode for large files.
config.pathStyle: Path format used when copying path with line numbers.
config.pathStyle.relative: Path relative to the workspace folder; falls back to the absolute path when no workspace is open.
config.pathStyle.tilde: Path starting with ~ when the file is under your home directory; otherwise the absolute path.
config.separator: Separator between path and line numbers (any string).
config.multiLineFormat: How to format multiple selected lines.
config.multiLineFormat.range: Merge consecutive lines into ranges, e.g. path:3-4,8.
config.multiLineFormat.list: List every line number, e.g. path:3,4,8.
config.multiLineFormat.perLine: One line per line number, e.g. path:3 / path:4 / path:8.
config.alignTemplates: Named regular expression templates for Align by RegEx, e.g. { "assign": "=|,|:" }.
config.promptSizeMB: Offer plain text mode when an opened file is at least this many MB. Set to 0 to never ask.
config.autoApplyExtensions: File extensions that always open in plain text mode without asking, e.g. [".log", ".csv"].
config.advanced:
Incremental overrides for built-in defaults: only the keys you set change, everything else keeps its built-in value. Unknown keys and values of the wrong type are ignored, never rejected.

All available keys, with their built-in defaults:

- `copyPath.useLineCountSyntax` — boolean, default `false`
- `changeCase.includeDotInCurrentWord` — boolean, default `false`
- `alignByRegex.rememberLastInput` — boolean, default `true`
- `plainText.applyEditorSettings` — boolean, default `true`
- `plainText.disableLineNumbers` — boolean, default `false`
- `plainText.editorOverrides` — object, default `{}`, applied on top of 29 built-in `[plaintext]` overrides (that key documents the full table)

Edit in settings.json for completion on every key, or insert the `All built-in defaults` snippet to get the whole object written out.
advanced.useLineCountSyntax:
Write a multi-line fragment as `a+n` (start line plus number of lines) instead of the closed interval `a-b`. Single lines stay `a` and multiple fragments stay comma separated either way, and this only affects `copyPath.multiLineFormat: range`.

Values `true` | `false`, built-in default `false`. Example: `src/a.ts:12+3` instead of `src/a.ts:12-14`.
advanced.includeDotInCurrentWord:
When converting the word under the cursor (empty selection), treat `.` as part of the word. Change Case always treats `_`, `-`, `/` and `$` as word characters; this key only controls the dot.

Values `true` | `false`, built-in default `false`. With the cursor on `baz` in `foo_bar.baz`: `true` converts all of `foo_bar.baz`, `false` converts only `baz`.
advanced.rememberLastInput:
Prefill the Align by RegEx input box with the expression used last time. Kept in memory for the current window only, never written to disk.

Values `true` | `false`, built-in default `true`.
advanced.applyEditorSettings:
In plain text mode, write the `[plaintext]` language-scoped editor overrides listed under `plainText.editorOverrides`. Set to `false` to only switch the document language to plaintext and leave all settings untouched.

Values `true` | `false`, built-in default `true`.
advanced.disableLineNumbers:
Also turn off line numbers for editors in plain text mode. This changes the editor's view options, not your `editor.lineNumbers` setting, and is restored on exit.

Values `true` | `false`, built-in default `false`.
advanced.editorOverrides:
Incremental changes to the built-in `[plaintext]` editor overrides. Set a setting id to a value to change it, or to `null` to drop the built-in override entirely (which restores your normal setting for plain text files). Any `editor.*` id is accepted, including ones not listed here.

The 29 built-in overrides, all applied under the `[plaintext]` language scope:

Rendering — `editor.minimap.enabled`: `false`, `editor.wordWrap`: `"off"` (`off` | `on` | `wordWrapColumn` | `bounded`), `editor.folding`: `false`, `editor.stickyScroll.enabled`: `false`, `editor.bracketPairColorization.enabled`: `false`, `editor.guides.indentation`: `false`, `editor.guides.bracketPairs`: `false`, `editor.matchBrackets`: `"never"` (`always` | `near` | `never`), `editor.occurrencesHighlight`: `"off"` (`off` | `singleFile` | `multiFile`), `editor.selectionHighlight`: `false`, `editor.renderWhitespace`: `"none"` (`none` | `boundary` | `selection` | `trailing` | `all`), `editor.renderControlCharacters`: `false`, `editor.codeLens`: `false`, `editor.colorDecorators`: `false`, `editor.links`: `false`.

Language features — `editor.hover.enabled`: `false`, `editor.parameterHints.enabled`: `false`, `editor.suggestOnTriggerCharacters`: `false`, `editor.wordBasedSuggestions`: `"off"` (`off` | `currentDocument` | `matchingDocuments` | `allDocuments`), `editor.quickSuggestions`: `{ "other": false, "comments": false, "strings": false }`, `editor.formatOnType`: `false`, `editor.formatOnPaste`: `false`, `editor.semanticHighlighting.enabled`: `false`.

Editing — `editor.autoClosingBrackets`: `"never"` (`always` | `languageDefined` | `beforeWhitespace` | `never`), `editor.autoClosingQuotes`: `"never"` (same values), `editor.trimAutoWhitespace`: `false`.

Unicode scanners — `editor.unicodeHighlight.nonBasicASCII`: `false`, `editor.unicodeHighlight.invisibleCharacters`: `false`, `editor.unicodeHighlight.ambiguousCharacters`: `false`.

Example: `{ "editor.wordWrap": "on", "editor.minimap.enabled": null }` turns word wrap back on and stops overriding the minimap.
snippet.advanced.allDefaultsDetail: Write out every advanced key with its built-in default value, ready to edit.
snippet.editorOverrides.builtinDetail: Write out the full built-in override table, ready to edit. Identical to leaving this object empty.
snippet.editorOverrides.restoreDetail: Turn word wrap back on and remove the built-in minimap override with null.
